item.title: CP2077 VR Modder Hit by Another DMCA Strike, Pauses Patreon, Pulls Access to All His Mods
item.description: The creator of the Cyberpunk 2077 VR mod CD Projekt recently hit with a DMCA strike has paused his Patreon page and pulled access to all his mods after receiving another strike from a different publisher.

item.title: PlayStation Store "New Year Deals" Kicks Off the First Sale of 2026
item.description: The PlayStation Store "New Year Deals" is live, and it's the first promotion by Sony for 2026.

item.title: The strategic autobattler, Turnbound, is now available via Steam EA
item.description: "Independent studio 1TK Games is excited to announce that Turnbound, its strategic autobattler built around experimentation and mastery, is now available in Early Access on Steam." - 1TK Games.

item.title: World of Warcraft's add-on changes aren't over 'There will doubtless be some loopholes players find'
item.description: A 12.0.1 patch will bring more changes after this week's Midnight expansion prepatch made dramatic changes to mods, character classes and the game's UI.

item.title: Fallout lead says "spaghetti code" has nothing to do with being a "stupid, lazy programmer"
item.description: Fallout co-creator Timothy Cain wants you to know that unreadable, so-called "spaghetti code" in video games isn't a matter of discipline or genius developers just never have enough time to do their jobs.

item.title: Vampire Survivors' highly anticipated deck-building spin-off is getting an Xbox and Steam demo soon
item.description: If you're one of the 200K+ people who've already excitedly wish-listed Vampire Survivors' much-anticipated deck-building spin-off Vampire Crawlers, there's some good news to carry you into the weekend: a demo is arriving for Steam and Xbox Game Pass on 23rd February.

item.title: ARC Raiders Roadmap: January - April 2026
item.description: Embark writes: "As we head into 2026, were excited to share our roadmap for the next four months. This will show you the types of new content to look forward to: new enemies, maps, conditions, or other changes. As you can expect, were not going to offer all the specifics, but enough that you know where were heading."

item.title: Nexus Mods - Our Focus For 2026
item.description: Iluviel writes: "Were also committing to supporting Vortex on SteamOS. Well be targeting vanilla Steam hardware like the Steam Deck and Steam Machine. We wont be officially supporting any other configurations, but as Vortex is an open source project community developers will be free to extend support for their preferred Linux distros as they please."

item.title: Mass Effect boss Michael Gamble is looking for a production director for the next game in the series
item.description: The most recent sign of progress comes from Mass Effect executive producer Michael Gamble, who's looking for help getting the new game done. "Hi, Im hiring a very important senior leadership role," Gamble wrote on X. "Theyll report to me and its gonna be awesome."

item.title: NS2 Best-Seller as Sales Top 16M LT - Worldwide Hardware Estimates for December 2025
item.description: The Nintendo Switch 2 was the best-selling console worldwide with 3,813,393 units sold for December 2025, according to VGChartz estimates. The Switch 2 has sold 16.09 million units lifetime. The PlayStation 5 was the second best-selling console, with an estimated 3,382,873 units sold, to bring lifetime sales to 89.44 million units.
